name: DiceBear HTTP API
description: Keyless hosted endpoint returning deterministic avatars (SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF) from a seed in the URL.

restrictions: API free for non-commercial use only; commercial use or higher limits: self-host
Style licences still apply to output
No availability guarantee; may change output
license.notes: Service terms from the DiceBear docs, fetched 2026-11-14.

cost.notes: Limits 2026-11: 50 req/s SVG, 10 req/s raster (raster capped at 256 px). Self-hosting recommended for commercial use.

verdictReason: Only genuinely keyless, free, deterministic remote service found; ideal real remote/async path for the MVP (with self-host seam).
